verses.1: And on the day of the Sabbath, Mary Magdalene, Mary from Jacob’s household, and Salome each took ointments, so that they could anoint him with them.
verses.2: And on the last day of the Sabbaths, they came to the tomb of the sun god.
verses.3: And they said to themselves, “Who will take the stone out of the door of the tomb?”
verses.4: And when he looked down at it, he saw that the stone was completely broken apart, as it was extremely large in size.
verses.5: And when I entered the tomb, I saw a young man sitting there on the right side, wearing a white robe. His body was covered with cloth.
verses.6: And he said to them, “Do not go there. Go instead and ask for Jesus Nazarite, the one who was crucified. He replied, “There is no such person here. Look at the place where he was crucified.”
verses.7: But tell his disciples and Peter that he is leading you to Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.
verses.8: And when they left the tomb, they were filled with fear and horror. They said nothing to anyone, because they were too afraid. All those who heard about Peter’s resurrection quickly spread the news. After that, Jesus himself, from the east to the west, sent out his message of eternal salvation through them. Amen.
verses.9: On the first day of Sunday, Anastasius first appeared before Mary Magdalene. Seven demons were cast out from her by his presence.
verses.10: She went there and told those who were with her that they should mourn and weep.
verses.11: When they heard that she was still alive and that she was being cared for by others, they were overjoyed.
verses.12: After that, they were unable to move around freely. They became visible in another form, being carried away into the fields.
verses.13: They went away and reported to the others. But they didn’t believe them either.
verses.14: But then, it became clear to those eleven of them. They realized their lack of faith and their cruel heartedness, since they did not believe in him after seeing him suffer like that.
verses.15: And he said to them: “As you go throughout the world, proclaim the gospel to everyone.”
verses.16: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; he who does not believe will be condemned.
verses.17: But those who believe should keep these things in mind. In my name, demons will be released; they will speak through their tongues and act in ways that are unacceptable.
verses.18: Even if they are dead, they will still be able to heal themselves; they won’t be harmed. They will simply touch the sickly hands and heal them properly.
verses.19: So, after speaking to them, Lord Jesus ascended into heaven and sat at God’s right hand.
verses.20: And those who went out did so, proclaiming that they were servants of the Lord and that they believed in His words through the signs that followed.
